HTI5001 · slide-by-slide index into Tortora & Derrickson 16e

Tortora Companion

For every slide: the chapter and section, the printed page and the PDF page (printed + 16), exactly which paragraphs and figures to capture, then the idea explained from the basics with the basic terms defined.

How to read a capture line. "p.206 right column" means the printed page number in the book's corner; the PDF page shown under it is what your PDF viewer's page box wants (printed + 16 in this copy). Column and heading tell you where on the page; the opening words tell you which paragraph. Figures and tables are given by their own numbers so they can be found from the figure list. When the slide and the book disagree, the yellow note says so; the book wins for definitions, the slide wins for what the lecturer will ask.
